title: Danak published index, v1
description: The entry point of a published content set (/v1/index.json). Lists every Danak in feed order with the path of its file and the SHA-256 of that file's bytes. Files are named by content hash, so they never change once published: a client fetches only entries whose sha256 it does not already have.

path.description: Relative to the index. The file holds one Danak as defined in danak-v1.schema.json#/$defs/danak; its image.src is relative to the same directory as this index.
